verdict.rationale: Context.dev clearly supports crawling with configurable maximum page limits (500 pages synchronously, up to 25,000 pages via async batch crawl), satisfying the page-limit part of the story. However, none of the docs mention a selectable crawl strategy (breadth-first vs depth-first) or any parameter to configure traversal order. Missing for 10: explicit breadth-first crawl strategy option, documentation of crawl traversal algorithm, and independent confirmation of strategy behavior.
